title: Understanding SVD Output
text: The singular values in Sigma represent the variance captured by each principal component. A larger singular value indicates more variance along that direction.

title: Interpreting $$V_T$$
text: The matrix $$V_T$$ contains the principal components. Each row represents a direction in the original space. The first row corresponds to the direction of maximum variance.

title: Comparing Variance
text: Which plot shows the most variance along a single direction?

title: Direction of Principal Component
text: Which plot aligns with the direction given by the first row of $$V_T$$: $$[0.89238775$$, $$-0.45126944]$$?
